sloka: प्रगृह्य च महीपालो जलपूरितमञ्जलिम् ।दिशं याम्यामभिमुखो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ २.१०२.२६॥
transliteration: pragṛhya ca mahīpālo jalapūritamañjalim ।diśaṁ yāmyāmabhimukho rudan vacanamabravīt ॥ 2.102.26॥

translations.english: Rama, the ruler of the earth, held water with both palms cupped and, facing the south, the direction of Yama (the god of death) said these words, sobbing:
